- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml (identical twin: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml): step "Require successful CI lint check-run" | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The first operand tests string length, so a zero-padded value longer than four characters is rejected even when numerically within 0..2400 and replaced by 600.
  WHY: A configured wait such as `00010` gets a different wait period and a misleading warning; the failure direction is safe because the release only waits for the wrong period.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml (identical twin: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml): `gate_polls_left=$((gate_wait_secs / gate_poll_secs))`, with `gate_poll_secs=30` | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Integer division rounds the wait budget down to whole 30-second polls, so any positive wait below 30 gives zero polls.
  WHY: With `STABLE_RELEASE_CI_WAIT_SECS=10`, a missing or still-running `lint` check-run on the first read fails the release immediately.

  PROBLEM: The length-based check incorrectly caps valid numeric wait values under 2400 if they are zero-padded to more than four digits.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml (and the byte-identical twin test-and-mark-stable.yml:6408): lines 741-748, specifically `if [ "${#gate_wait_secs}" -gt 4 ] || [ "$((10#${gate_wait_secs}))" -gt 2400 ]; then` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The four-character length cap fires before the numeric check, so zero-padded values longer than four digits are replaced with 600 even when their numeric value is within 0..2400.
  WHY: For example, `STABLE_RELEASE_CI_WAIT_SECS=002400` falls back to 600 despite the documented range and leading-zero behavior; the warning is misleading, and the existing tests do not cover an in-range value of length five or more.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml (and the byte-identical twin test-and-mark-stable.yml:6414): line 750, `gate_polls_left=$((gate_wait_secs / gate_poll_secs))` with `gate_poll_secs=30` set immediately above | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Integer division truncates positive wait budgets below 30 seconds to zero polls.
  WHY: With `STABLE_RELEASE_CI_WAIT_SECS=10`, the first non-pass verdict fails immediately rather than waiting; the existing tests do not cover values in the 1..29 range.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "fix #6532 in only those five paths" (the two release workflows, one test file, `README.md`, and one changelog fragment), as restated in the AI issue summary comment.
  Expected change site: The five paths named in the issue body.
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds a sixth changed path, `agents.d/6873-stable-release-switch.md`, which registers `STABLE_RELEASE_SWITCH`, `STABLE_RELEASE_CI_GATE` and `STABLE_RELEASE_DISABLED` under "Stable log prefixes (contractual)". That file is required by the project's §30 rule (log-prefix registration must go through an `agents.d/` fragment, never a direct edit of `agents.md`), but the five-path grant body in the issue does not include `agents.md` or `agents.d/` and therefore does not cover this fragment under the §30 scope-coverage rule. The implement guard would refuse this PR on the same basis. The fragment needs to be brought into the grant (or its scope updated to include `agents.md`/`agents.d/`) for the PR to land cleanly. The PR description ("Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6873") does not record this deviation either.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
